configuration.pe_policy: One frozen official PE rewrite per input prompt, same rewritten text across all diffusion seeds. Measures image stability conditional on this rewrite; does not establish rewrite stability across PE seeds.

acceptance.geometry_rule: Measure bar tops relative to shared baseline and y-axis tick calibration; max error 2 units on 0-100 scale, inclusive. Exact category/value text, order, axis ticks and four bars required; no extra/missing data. Layout may move. Geometry and text independently assessed. Ambiguous image fails pending review.

configuration.minimal_prompt: 横向3:2白底柱状图，标题‘测试数据’。单系列四根蓝色竖直矩形柱，从左到右：甲=20、乙=70、丙=40、丁=90。纵轴从0到100，刻度0、20、40、60、80、100等距排列，共用零基线；柱高严格按数值线性比例。每根柱下方写类别，顶端标数值。仅显示标题、类别、数值和纵轴刻度。
configuration.detail_append: 版面采用精致的现代数据报告设计：顶部标题居中，深海军蓝无衬线字体，字重均匀，细腻抗锯齿；四周宽阔留白，绘图区居中占主体，标签整齐对齐。柱体均为饱和湖蓝色，边缘利落，宽度一致，间距均匀，矩形平顶；坐标轴为纤细深灰线，水平网格为浅灰细线。标题下方加入一条短蓝色装饰线，四角加入很小的浅蓝几何点缀，背景带极淡纸张纹理，整体安静、清爽、专业。装饰不遮挡图表，不增加文字，保留全部既定数据和轴约束。
configuration.review: Human per-image text/axis review plus saved pixel measurements; no data overlays or repair in generated images. Debug excluded from confirmation; any iteration uses fresh held-out seeds.

git_policy: Generated PNGs and contact JPGs retained locally (ignored), all hashes/receipts/QC/scripts/reference inputs tracked. No remote in infograph-research.
